items.title: Finiteness of the cohomological dimension of finite type morphisms and finite type schemes over a field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a field K, every finite type morphism of K-schemes has finite cohomological dimension, and that if K itself has finite cohomological dimension then so does every finite type K-scheme (statement lines 20040-20049). The proof (proof lines 20051-20071) runs the induction principle twice: once with the affine base case and the relative Mayer-Vietoris sequence, and once with the affine bound and the absolute Mayer-Vietoris sequence. H2: two parallel inductive arguments, written out in full.
